author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Campusano goes deep Wednesday
desc: Luis Campusano went 2-for-3 with a home run in the Padres 10-4 win over the Diamondbacks on Wednesday.
impact: Campusano went deep to open the bottom of the sixth inning to begin what was a four-run frame for San Diego. He is up to four long balls on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Fernando Tatis Jr. steals two bases Wednesday
desc: Fernando Tatis Jr. went 2-for-4 with two steals in the Padres 10-4 win over the Diamondbacks on Wednesday.
impact: Tatis hit an RBI single as part of a four-run sixth inning for San Diego. He is up to 23 stolen bases on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael King earns win Wednesday
desc: Michael King allowed one run on four hits over six innings with four strikeouts and two walks in a win on Wednesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: King allowed his lone run in the first inning before he was able to settle in for a quality start. It was his third quality start in his last four outings heading into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy Troy hits home run Wednesday
desc: Tommy Troy went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Diamondbacks 10-4 loss against the Padres on Wednesday.
impact: Troy hit a two-run home run in the seventh inning with Arizona trailing 8-1. It was his fourth time going deep this year.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Cabrera allows four runs Wednesday
desc: Jose Cabrera allowed four runs on four hits over 4 1/3 innings with two strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Wednesday against the Padres.
impact: Cabrera had allowed just two runs through four innings before allowing two more runs in the fifth inning when he was removed. He'll remain off the fantasy radar heading into the second half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Kirby tosses quality start in loss Wednesday
desc: George Kirby allowed two runs on eight hits over six innings with seven strikeouts in a loss on Wednesday against the Marlins.
impact: Kirby pitched well enough to earn the win, but he got no run support from the Mariners lineup. He continued his recent strong performances into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Jones tosses six perfect innings Wednesday
desc: Jared Jones struck out eight over six perfect innings in a no-decision on Wednesday against the Braves.
impact: Jones was removed after throwing 77 pitches and the game being a scoreless tie. He'll look to carry the momentum into the second half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Stuart Fairchild signs minor league deal with Mariners
desc: The Mariners signed Stuart Fairchild to a minor league contract.
impact: Fairchild will add outfield depth in the Mariners organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Suarez to open for Athletics Thursday
desc: José Suarez will open the game on Thursday for the Athletics.
impact: Suarez will likely pitch the first inning or two before a bulk reliever follows him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dan Hammer to be called up by Mets
desc: The Mets are calling up Dan Hammer.
impact: Hammer will add an extra arm in the bullpen for the Mets. He has posted a 1.77 ERA over 17 appearances with Triple-A Syracuse. He'll be making his major league debut.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Kurtz (illness) considered day-to-day
desc: Nick Kurtz is considered day-to-day after leaving Wednesday's game early with an illness.
impact: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said Kurtz was throwing up in the dugout. "I don't think there's much in his stomach right now," he said.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Willson Contreras day-to-day with foot contusion
desc: Willson Contreras is day-to-day with a left foot contusion.
impact: Contreras left Wednesday's game early after fouling a pitch off his left foot. It appears he avoided anything too significant.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tim Herrin (elbow) has X-rays return negative
desc: Tim Herrin underwent X-rays that came back negative for any fractures.
impact: Herrin took a comebacker off his pitching elbow during Wednesday's game against the Twins. He is day-to-day going into Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dillon Dingler (hand) has X-rays return negative
desc: Dillon Dingler had X-rays return negative for any fractures.
impact: Dingler will continue to undergo further imaging. He is day-to-day going into Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Seigler (trap) exits early Wednesday
desc: Anthony Seigler was removed from Wednesday's game against the White Sox with a right trap contusion.
impact: Seigler suffered the injury on a collision at home plate. He will be further evaluated into Thursday.
